bias.en: Bearish · stalling under the September lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 受制于 9 月低点下方

read.en: Broadcom was flat on Oct 20, down 0.1% to $334.37, trading between $330.80 and $341.09. It is below its 5-day ($337.7), 10-day ($349.9), 30-day ($353.1), 100-day ($378.5) and 200-day ($368.1) averages, all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 15 and below zero with a widening gap, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($368.76), and RSI is 38.6.

Again the high stalled near $341 and the close sat just under $335, while the $328.6 Oct 16 low held. Resistance is $335–341 (Sep 16 and Oct 15 lows, 5-day average, Oct 20 high), then $343.3 (Oct 1 low) and $350–353 (10 and 30-day). Support is $328.6, then $321–324 (Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows) and $314–316. A close below $321 would open $315.

r.en: Sep 16 and Oct 15 lows; 5-day average $337.7; Oct 20 high $341.1
